scenario: M1 scenario 1: the phone number has just been confirmed. Anna must ask for consent to store the name and phone before fetching slots or booking.

success_condition: The agent asks whether the caller agrees that SCG stores her name and phone for this request, and calls neither get_slots nor book_inspection in this turn.
